candidates.description: This vector represents concepts and terminology related to comparison, similarity, and difference.
This vector is related to cognitive processes and verbs of perception, comprehension, and knowledge.
This vector represents states of mental awareness, mindfulness, and cognitive perception, including related suffixes and opposing concepts.
This vector represents concepts, terminology, and figures associated with Eastern religions and philosophies, particularly Buddhism and Hinduism.
This feature vector represents quantifiers and determiners indicating amount, selection, or distribution.
This vector represents the concept of shared systems of belief, traditions, and cultural practices.
These tokens represent the concept of utmost importance, centrality, or foundational necessity.
This vector represents comparative adjectives expressing degree, extent, or relative magnitude.
This feature vector activates on concepts, terminology, and specific examples related to global religions, theological traditions, and faith-based practices.
This feature vector activates on adverbs of degree, extent, and qualification that modify verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs.
